cards.title: Momentum swings to Ashvale Rovers
cards.headline: Ashvale Rovers Take Clear Control Early
cards.story: Ashvale Rovers have shifted momentum decisively, controlling 56.6% possession over the last five minutes and registering the only shot with an expected goal value of 0.18. This clear dominance in a contested tempo sets them up as the team to watch for breaking the deadlock.

claims.text: Ashvale Rovers hold 56.6% possession in the last five minutes.
They have taken the only shot so far, with an xG of 0.18.
The pulse dominance strength is clear in favor of Ashvale Rovers.

en.caption: Ashvale Rovers press with 56.6% possession, 0.18 xG, and clear pulse dominance in last 5 minutes.

fr.caption: Ashvale Rovers contrôlent 56,6% de possession, 0,18 xG et dominent clairement le tempo sur 5 dernières minutes.

ar.caption: أشفيل روفرز يسيطرون على الكرة بنسبة 56.6% مع xG 0.18 وهيمنة واضحة خلال آخر 5 دقائق.

en.caption: Ashvale Rovers have the ball more and made the only shot so far in the last 5 minutes.

fr.caption: Ashvale Rovers ont plus le ballon et ont tiré une fois ces 5 dernières minutes.

cards.title: The game breaks open
cards.headline: The game breaks open
cards.story: Control is gone: 4.0 turnovers a minute over the last five minutes, with the ball changing hands faster than either side can set up.

claims.text: 4.0 turnovers per minute in the last five minutes.
Chaos index 1.37, where 1 is this match's normal tempo.

en.caption: 4 turnovers per minute last 5 mins, chaos index 1.37 signals disrupted control and rapid ball changes.

fr.caption: 4 pertes de balle par minute sur 5 dernières, indice chaos 1,37 indique contrôle rompu et échanges rapides.

ar.caption: 4 فقدات للكرة في الدقيقة خلال آخر 5 دقائق، مؤشر الفوضى 1.37 يدل على تحكم مضطرب وتبادل سريع.

en.caption: The game is wild now: the ball changes hands 4 times a minute, making it hard for teams to settle.

fr.caption: Le match est fou : le ballon change de camp 4 fois par minute, les équipes peinent à s'organiser.

ar.caption: المباراة أصبحت فوضوية: الكرة تتغير 4 مرات في الدقيقة، مما يصعب على الفرق السيطرة.

issues: Claim of 'clear control' and 'growing dominance' since the 9th minute is unsupported; facts only show dominance in last 5 minutes, no timeline for momentum shift.
Mention of Kestrel Bay's struggle to respond is an invented context not supported by facts.
Headline 'Ashvale Rovers dominate with chaotic control' overstates dominance; facts show dominance in last 5 minutes but not overall control.

Claim of 'clear dominance over the last five minutes' is contradicted by shots_last5_home being 2, not 3 as implied by total home shots; the total home shots are 3 but only 2 in last 5 minutes, so dominance claim over last 5 minutes is overstated.
Claim that Ashvale Rovers generated 3 shots in last five minutes is incorrect; facts show only 2 shots in last 5 minutes, total home shots are 3.
The story implies a sudden spike in intensity opening scoring opportunities, but facts do not provide evidence of increased xG or shots in last 5 minutes to support this causal inference.

fallbacks: analyst: overturned twice, rulebook-safe version aired
